name: 92210 · Indian Wells, CA
findings: ZIP 92210 (Indian Wells) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92210 (Indian Wells) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92210 (Indian Wells) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
